properties.description: TA-10.3 '5xx spike' (P1): > 5% of requests over 10 min. Built-in AI 'requests' table (resultCode is AI built-in request telemetry via TA-10.5 Serilog -> AI, not a TA-10.2 name). No dedicated API-health dashboard in TA-10.4 — links to 'Business' (closest live tile, id 3e32757d-996d-4142-a9f6-33cf2e56d051, docs/dashboards/business.json). dev: informational (launch traffic is synthetic)

allOf.query:
requests
| where timestamp >= ago(10m)
| summarize total = count(), fiveHundred = count_if(resultCode >= 500)
| extend pct5xx = 100.0 * fiveHundred / max(total, 1)
